property_summary: For any caller and any ether amount, calling C's fallback succeeds (does not revert) exactly when msg.value == 10 ether; the mutant requiring 5 ether makes some calls succeed that the reference would revert on, so the acceptance predicate differs.
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 5 ether (single-statement rewrite of the first require).
